author: mfhansen
title: PyTorch Models tests fail with pyarrow/NumPy ABI mismatch (ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0)
signature: pyarrow requires numpy 2.0 or newer but older numpy installed causing importerror in datasets/pyarrow dependency chain|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 7 test_hf_transformers.py tests fail with multiprocessing.context.ProcessError wrapping ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4

key_errors:
File "install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_hf_transformers.py", line 59, in load_model
    from datasets import Audio, load_dataset
  File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/datasets/__init__.py", line 17, in <module>
    from .arrow_dataset import Dataset
  File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/datasets/arrow_dataset.py", line 60, in <module>
    import pyarrow as pa
  File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pyarrow/__init__.py", line 59, in <module>
    from pyarrow.lib import (BuildInfo, CppBuildInfo, RuntimeInfo, set_timezone_db_path,
ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4
root_cause: tests/requirements_pytorch pins numpy==1.26.4 for python_version < 3.12 (line 7), but the installed pyarrow wheel (pulled transitively via the datasets package used by test_hf_transformers.py) requires NumPy >= 2.0 at import time. pip installs both packages without conflict (no hard pyarrow<->numpy version constraint is declared), so the environment ends up with an ABI-incompatible pyarrow/numpy pair. Every test that imports `datasets` (which imports pyarrow) fails immediately at import time, independent of the PR under test (PR #39512 only touches a benchmarks CSV file).
reproduction_steps: pip install -r tests/requirements_pytorch (locks numpy==1.26.4), then pip install -r install/tests/model_hub_tests/requirements.txt_pytorch or equivalent to pull in `datasets`/pyarrow, then run: python3 -m pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_hf_transformers.py -k test_convert_model_precommit. The ImportError reproduces on the first `from datasets import ...` call.
recommended_actions: Pin pyarrow explicitly in the pytorch model-hub test requirements to a version built against NumPy 1.x (e.g. pyarrow<17), or bump tests/requirements_pytorch's numpy pin to >=2.0 for python_version < 3.12 if downstream model-hub tests tolerate it.
Add an explicit `datasets`/`pyarrow` version constraint near the numpy==1.26.4 pin in tests/requirements_pytorch so pip's resolver cannot select an incompatible pyarrow build.
Re-run the PyTorch Models tests job after the pin is corrected to confirm all 7 previously failing test_hf_transformers.py cases pass.
prevention_strategies: When pinning numpy for compatibility reasons, also audit and pin transitive packages (pyarrow, datasets) that have hard NumPy ABI version floors, and add a CI smoke check that imports `datasets`/pyarrow right after requirements installation to fail fast with a clear message instead of deep inside a multiprocessing worker.
historical_context: This exact signature has now recurred 6 times since 2026-11-05 (first seen 2026-11-05T01:47:23Z, most recently on run 42251178938 at 2026-11-06T18:08:04Z, now again on run 42647164675), always on unrelated merge-queue PRs, confirming the break stems from the requirements_pytorch/pyarrow pin mismatch rather than any PR content.
